post.description: Generation requires the durable LLM workflow (otherwise 503 workflowUnavailable), an owned working draftId, expectedRevision, and a stable UUID operationId or Idempotency-Key. Returns 202 for pending work; poll statusUrl until terminal. Client snapshots are not authoritative.
